response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.name, cr.points FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId WHERE cr.points > 1.0), race_avg AS (SELECT raceId, name, AVG(points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS result_count FROM filtered GROUP BY raceId, name), name_avg AS (SELECT name, AVG(avg_points) AS name_avg FROM race_avg GROUP BY name) SELECT ra.raceId, ra.name, ra.avg_points, ra.result_count, ra.avg_points / na.name_avg AS ratio FROM race_avg ra JOIN name_avg na ON na.name = ra.name ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
